Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK 1.0 All necessary tools for completing the service/ overhauling work are under the scope of the contract or. 2.0 Removing the oil from the compartment. 3.0 Lifting of diverter switch insert from the oil compartment. 4.0 Dismantling of diverter switch, Cleaning & Inspection of contacts and all the insulating parts as requ ired. 5.0 Measurement of Transition resistance with Multi meter 6.0 Inspection of Braid, Tightness and healthiness of insulation components 7.0 Cleaning with fresh oil 8.0 Re- assembly of diverter switch 9.0 Inspection and Cleaning of diverter switch oil compartment 10.0 Cleaning & inspection of Drive mechanism 11.0 Greasing of Top Drive Unit & Bevel Gear 12.0 Check the coupling components of all the poles 13.0 Inspection of Protective relay, Bevel Gear & its shaft assembly 14.0 Checks raise and lower operations of all taps manually and electrically from local and remote. ***** 2. 4.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of t he NLCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. No pro vision has been made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 6.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contrac t Workmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/- from every contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NLCIL from their salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be made from the bills of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & F orm -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workma n / Supervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / U nit Accounts Centre. 7.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor s hall also produce the required age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 8.0 ESI & EPF The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of re mitting the contribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workmen / Supervisor / Engineer / Technician engaged by them towards EPF, ESI etc., (as applicable). 9.0 SAFETY Personal protective equipments (PPE) ie like Helmet, Safety shoe, Goggles etc b y to be provided by the contractor and it is in the scope of the contractor. 10.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Time is the essence of the contract. In case the contractor fails to complete the works within the stip ulated period (as mentioned in Sl.No.13.2 of Part-II Special Conditions), then, unless such a fa ilure is due to Force Majeure or due to Purchaser’s defaults, the total contract price shall be reduced by ½% (half percent) of the total contract price per week of delay or part thereof subject to a maxim um of 5% of the total contract price, by way of reduction in price for delay and not as penalty. 11.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY Not Applicable 12.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable 13.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT 13.1 24 (Twenty four) months from service start date as per GeM contract. Note: Lead days of 1 day are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offering service. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 1 day after contract genera tion date. 13.2 Period of work

15 days after handing over the site (transformer). 14.0 PAYMENT TERMS 14.1 Payment will be made on pro-rata basis after completion of servicing in all aspects. 14.2 The payment will be made within 15 days on receipt and acceptance of invoice. 14.3 The final bill will be paid only after the finalisation of contract. 15.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant docume ntary evidence. Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules. 16.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances. 17.0 The General Conditions clauses 12.0 & 35.19 are not applicable. **** . 3.
